---
pagetitle: "IMSLU Weekly Report"
format:
  html:
    minimal: true
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup}
# Monday weekly report for all faculty and residents. Connect renders this
# page; a Power Automate flow fetches it and emails it, so the output is
# email-safe HTML only (see R/email_html.R). Program, class and PCEC-team
# totals only; the only names are the shout-outs.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
})
source("R/report_data.R")
source("R/report_metrics.R")
source("R/email_html.R")

# REPORT_AS_OF (YYYY-MM-DD) renders the report as of another date, for
# testing. Unset in production.
as_of <- as.Date(Sys.getenv("REPORT_AS_OF", unset = as.character(Sys.Date())))
d <- load_report_data(as_of)

ass  <- assessment_summary(d)
fev  <- faculty_eval_summary(d)
conf <- conference_summary(d)
duty <- duty_logging_summary(d)
peer <- peer_summary(d)
mk   <- mksap_summary(d)
cc   <- clinic_team_summary(d)

URL <- list(
  assessment = "https://fbuckhold3-imslu-resident-assessment.share.connect.posit.cloud",
  noon       = "https://fbuckhold3-imslu-at-noon.share.connect.posit.cloud",
  # Resident quick-entry app (the Friday digest's app); ?section= deep links.
  digest     = "https://01a0afbe-d624-6e3d-f643-5c2b2a613602.share.connect.posit.cloud"
)
# Faculty evaluation entry lives in the resident apps now (the standalone
# imslu.facultyeval app is retired). Same gmed::mod_faculty_eval form as
# the resident dashboard, which has no page-level deep link.
URL$faculty <- paste0(URL$digest, "?section=faculty_eval")

wk_lab  <- sprintf("%s – %s", fmt_date(d$week$start, "%b %e"), fmt_date(d$week$end, "%b %e, %Y"))
ay_lab  <- sprintf("%d–%02d", d$ay, (d$ay + 1) %% 100)
wk_conf <- conf$week |> filter(class == "Program")
cc_open <- cc$quarters |> filter(window == "current")
cc_prog <- cc$teams |> filter(team == "Program")
```

```{r body}
#| results: asis
out <- character()
add <- function(...) out <<- c(out, ...)

add(sprintf('<div style="font-family:-apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; max-width:680px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 12px; color:%s;">', COL$text))
add(sprintf('<h1 style="color:%s; font-size:1.5rem; margin:16px 0 2px;">IMSLU Weekly Report</h1>', COL$navy))
add(small(sprintf("Week of %s · Academic year %s · Data as of %s",
                  wk_lab, ay_lab, fmt_date(d$as_of, "%A, %B %e"))))

# ── At a glance ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
glance <- list(
  list(value = ass$week, label = "Assessments of residents", sub = "last week"),
  list(value = fev$week, label = "Faculty evaluations by residents", sub = "last week"),
  list(value = pct(wk_conf$rate), label = "Noon conference attendance", sub = "last week, of expected days")
)
if (nrow(cc_open)) {
  q <- paste0("Q", cc_open$q)
  glance <- c(glance, list(list(value = sprintf("%d / %d", cc_prog[[q]], cc_prog$residents),
                                label = sprintf("%s continuity clinic evals", q), sub = "this quarter so far")))
}
add(kpi_row(glance))

add(p(link_button(URL$assessment, "Assess a resident"),
      link_button(URL$faculty, "Evaluate a faculty member"),
      link_button(URL$noon, "Log noon conference"),
      link_button(paste0(URL$digest, "?section=duty_hours"), "Log duty hours"),
      link_button(paste0(URL$digest, "?section=peer_review"), "Do a peer review")))

# ── Assessments of residents ────────────────────────────────────────────────
add(h2("Assessments of residents",
       "Faculty and fellow feedback is how residents improve and how the program judges competence."))
add(p(sprintf("We expect every resident to receive at least <strong>%d assessments a year</strong>, about one a week. Anyone who works with a resident, faculty or fellow, should be giving feedback. It takes a few minutes on a phone, with voice-to-text.",
              ANNUAL_TARGET)))
add(kpi_row(list(
  list(value = num(ass$last4), label = "Last 4 weeks"),
  list(value = num(ass$ay), label = "This academic year"),
  list(value = pct(ass$pace$share), label = "Residents on pace for 25",
       sub = sprintf("%.0f+ by now · median %s", floor(ass$pace$expected), num(ass$pace$median)))
)))
add(h3("By assessment type"))
add(html_table(ass$by_type |>
                 transmute(Type = esc(ass_type), `Last 4 weeks` = num(last4), `This year` = num(ay))))
if (nrow(ass$by_service)) {
  top <- ass$by_service |> slice_head(n = 10)
  add(h3("Who gave them: last 4 weeks, by service"))
  add(bar_rows(top$ass_specialty, top$n / max(top$n), num(top$n)))
}
if (nrow(ass$top_faculty)) {
  add(h3("Faculty champions: last 4 weeks"))
  add(p(sprintf("Thank you to <strong>%s</strong> for leading the way with %d assessments.",
                esc(ass$top_faculty$ass_faculty[1]), ass$top_faculty$n[1])))
  add(html_table(ass$top_faculty |> transmute(Faculty = esc(ass_faculty), Assessments = num(n))))
}

# ── Continuity clinic ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
add(h2("Continuity clinic evaluations",
       "Categorical residents, by PCEC team. One evaluation per resident per quarter: Q1 Jul–Sep (in-basket), Q2 Oct–Dec (summative), Q3 Jan–Mar (documentation), Q4 Apr–Jun (summative)."))
qcols <- paste0("Q", cc$quarters$q)
cc_tbl <- cc$teams |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(across(all_of(qcols), ~ done_cell(.x, residents, cc$quarters$window[cc$quarters$q == as.integer(sub("Q", "", cur_column()))]))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(Team = esc(team), Residents = as.character(residents), !!!rlang::syms(qcols),
            `Clinic observation` = sprintf("%d / %d", observed, residents))
names(cc_tbl)[names(cc_tbl) %in% qcols] <- paste0(qcols, ifelse(cc$quarters$window == "current", " (open)", ""))
add(html_table(cc_tbl, bold_last = TRUE))
add(small("Closed quarters: green ≥ 90% done, amber ≥ 60%, red below. \"Clinic observation\" = residents with at least one observation in clinic this year. Duplicate submissions are counted once."))

# ── Noon conference ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
add(h2("Noon conference attendance",
       "Attendance is expected of all residents: SLU Hospital conference when on the SSM campus, VA conference when at the VA."))
rate_tbl <- conf$ay |>
  select(class) |>
  left_join(conf$week |> select(class, week = rate), by = "class") |>
  left_join(conf$last4 |> select(class, last4 = rate), by = "class") |>
  left_join(conf$ay |> select(class, ay = rate), by = "class") |>
  mutate(class = factor(class, levels = c(CLASS_LEVELS, "Program"))) |>
  arrange(class) |>
  transmute(Class = as.character(class), `Last week` = pct(week), `Last 4 weeks` = pct(last4),
            `This year` = pct(ay))
add(html_table(rate_tbl, bold_last = TRUE))
ay_prog <- conf$ay |> filter(class == "Program")
add(small(sprintf("Share of expected conference days (from the Amion schedule) with attendance logged. This year: SLUH %s, VA %s. Late check-ins are counted when they're logged, so last week's rate usually rises.",
                  pct(ay_prog$rate_sluh), pct(ay_prog$rate_va))))
add(p(link_button(URL$noon, "Log noon conference")))

# ── Faculty evaluations by residents ────────────────────────────────────────
add(h2("Resident evaluations of faculty"))
add(p(sprintf("Residents are expected to complete <strong>%d faculty evaluations a year</strong>.", ANNUAL_TARGET)))
add(kpi_row(list(
  list(value = num(fev$last4), label = "Last 4 weeks"),
  list(value = num(fev$ay), label = "This academic year"),
  list(value = pct(fev$pace$share), label = "Residents on pace for 25",
       sub = sprintf("%.0f+ by now · median %s", floor(fev$pace$expected), num(fev$pace$median)))
)))
if (nrow(fev$top_residents)) {
  add(p(sprintf("Shout-out to <strong>%s</strong>, who led the last 4 weeks with %d evaluations.",
                esc(fev$top_residents$resident[1]), fev$top_residents$n[1])))
  add(html_table(fev$top_residents |> transmute(Resident = esc(resident), Evaluations = num(n))))
}
add(p(link_button(URL$faculty, "Evaluate a faculty member")))

# ── Also this week: duty hours, peer review, MKSAP ──────────────────────────
add(h2("Also tracking"))
add(h3("Duty hours"))
add(p(sprintf("Residents have confirmed or entered <strong>%s</strong> of their worked days this year (%s last week). %d of %d residents have logged at least once. Days not yet confirmed use the Amion schedule estimate.",
              pct(duty$ay$verified / max(duty$ay$days, 1)), pct(duty$week$verified / max(duty$week$days, 1)),
              duty$ay$residents, duty$n_residents)))
add(p(link_button(paste0(URL$digest, "?section=duty_hours"), "Log duty hours")))

add(h3("Peer review"))
add(p(sprintf("<strong>%d</strong> peer reviews this year (%d in the last 4 weeks), from %d of %d residents.",
              peer$ay, peer$last4, peer$reviewers, peer$n_residents)))
add(p(link_button(paste0(URL$digest, "?section=peer_review"), "Do a peer review")))

add(h3("MKSAP"))
if (is.null(mk)) {
  add(p("No MKSAP progress has been imported yet."))
} else {
  add(p(sprintf("Goal by %s: 1,000 questions for interns and 2,000 for PGY2s and PGY3s. Progress as of the ACP export on <strong>%s</strong>.",
                fmt_date(mk$due, "%B %e"), fmt_date(mk$export_date, "%B %e"))))
  add(html_table(mk$by_class |>
                   transmute(Class = as.character(class), `Median done` = num(median_done),
                             `Expected by then` = num(expected), Goal = num(goal),
                             `On pace` = pct(on_pace))))
  add(small("Categorical residents. \"Expected by then\" is linear from July 1 to April 1 at the export date. Residents without an export count as 0."))
}

add(sprintf('<hr style="margin:28px 0 8px; border:none; border-top:1px solid %s;">', COL$line))
add(small(sprintf("Automated weekly report, IMSLU Internal Medicine Residency. Generated %s. Questions? Contact the program office.",
                  fmt_date(Sys.time(), "%B %e, %Y %l:%M %p", tz = "America/Chicago"))))
add("</div>")

# Raw HTML block, so pandoc passes it through instead of reading the
# indented lines as Markdown code.
cat("```{=html}\n", paste(out, collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n", sep = "")
```
